items.title: Calcutta High Court blocks streaming of video on Modi-Adani ties after Adani files for defamation
items.summary: The Calcutta High Court recently ordered a ban on streaming the video titled "The Friendship Files| How Modi and Adani Stole India" after Adani Enterprises filed a defamation suit [Adani Enterprises Limited VS Sabeer Bhatia and Ors.] . Justice Aryak Dutt said that the injunction will remain in force till January 31, 2027, when the case will be heard next. The Court said that the video, made by Indian-American businessman Sabeer Bhatia in collaboration with another channel called "Shadow Citizens", is not a news report. Justice Dutt observed that the imputations that the Adani Group is complicit in, or has been shielded from accountability for, narcotics smuggling linked to terror funding or police violence against a farmer are not substantiated by any authority. It noted that the original video was already disabled, but Bhatia uploaded it again. It prima facie shows want of good faith, the Court added. "Constructive criticism or truthful reporting on the petitioner or on Government policy, backed by evidence, is not barred. Online content spreads quickly through reposts and re-uploads, and the injury to reputation from continued republication cannot be adequately compensated in money. If the order is not passed now, its purpose will be defeated by further dissemination before the respondents [Bhatia and others] can be heard," the Court said. It clarified that its order does not restrict "constructive criticism or fair reporting" on the Adani Group or any government policy. The Court passed the order after Adani Enterprises filed a defamation suit against Bhatia and others over a 36-minute video that was uploaded on October 9, 2026. The video was uploaded on Bhatia's YouTube channel in collaboration with another channel called "Shadow Citizens". It was also posted on X. The video garnered over 80,000 views on YouTube and X combined on October 9. In its suit, Adani Enterprises prayed for a bar on the circulation of the video by Bhatia and other YouTube channels. The company also sought an injunction against accounts on Meta and X. items.title: Supreme Court Collegium recommends 4 High Court judges for elevation as Chief Justices

Justice P Sam Koshy of the Telangana High Court has been recommended as Chief Justice of the Delhi High Court, while Calcutta High Court judge Justice Tapabrata Chakraborty has been recommended for appointment as Chief Justice of the Telangana High Court.
